chain.formula: chi(z) = c * integral_0^z dz'/H(z'); x=chi*cos(dec)*cos(ra), y=chi*cos(dec)*sin(ra), z_spatial=chi*sin(dec)
chain.note: z_spatial (Cartesian) kept unambiguously distinct from redshift z throughout the codebase

chain.construction: G_DESI = (V,E,W); W_ij = exp(-d_ij^2 / (2*epsilon^2)), weighted by WEIGHT_i*WEIGHT_j

gate1_run.epsilon_rule_CORRECTED: 1 x median NN separation (median-heuristic bandwidth, Gretton et al.), measured directly per subsample -- corrected from the prior 3x median NN rule during the CONTINUUM-LIMIT-L-DESI diagnostic investigation; see FC005_CONTINUUM_DIAGNOSTIC_REPORT.md section 3.3. The prior 3x rule produced a near-complete, non-local graph (30-65% edge density).

chain.verification: symmetric, row-sums ~0 to machine precision, v^T L v >= 0 over 200 random test vectors -- data/desi/dr1/fc005/derived/pilot_run_result.json; re-audited at N=2500 during the diagnostic investigation (FC005_CONTINUUM_DIAGNOSTIC_REPORT.md section 3.5) with no anomaly found

chain.formula_note_CORRECTED: Exponent corrected from eps^(5/2) to eps^(d+2)=eps^5 during the CONTINUUM-LIMIT-L-DESI diagnostic investigation: the workbook's own kernel (DC-002) is K(d^2/eps) with eps in length^2 units, but this code's build_kernel_graph implements K(d^2/eps^2) with eps in length units (the standard convention -- Belkin-Niyogi, Coifman-Lafon, Hein-Audibert-von Luxburg, Singer). Translating the workbook's length^2-unit exponent to this code's length-unit eps gives eps^(d+2). See FC005_CONTINUUM_DIAGNOSTIC_REPORT.md section 3.2. This correction alone does not achieve Gate 1 convergence.
chain.C_K: 15.749609945722419 (Gaussian kernel, analytic (2*pi)^(3/2), cross-checked numerically to 5 sig figs)

chain.formula: -Delta_h phi_n = lambda_n phi_n  =>  Spec used here is Spec(-L_tilde), NOT Spec(L_tilde)
chain.sign_convention_note: L_tilde -> Delta_h (negative semidefinite, per the workbook's own DC-009/DC-010); the physically meaningful lambda_n>=0 spectrum for the heat trace is Spec(-Delta_h) = Spec(-L_tilde). This sign flip is applied explicitly in compiler/backends/desi_fc005_pipeline.py::run_mathematical_convergence -- see the in-code comment for the full derivation. This is a bug fix made during Gate 1 execution, not a physics change: it corrects which operator's spectrum is computed, required by the equations exactly as given in the source workbook.
chain.solver: numpy.linalg.eigh (dense); solver_residual < 1e-20 at every (N,eps) point tested

chain.conclusion: Gate 1 (mathematical convergence) FAILED on real DESI DR1 LRG SGC data (0.4<=z<0.6 bin) with the tested (N,epsilon) refinement sequence, both before and after the diagnostic investigation's corrections (metric floor fix, normalization exponent fix, bandwidth rule fix). Per instruction, Gates 2 (curvature closure) and 3 (physical validation) were NOT entered. No heat trace, no (a0,a1,a2) fit, no curvature residual was computed for DESI -- those remain OPEN, never executed.

redshift/radial selection function alone (synthetic control converges)
survey boundary alone (interior-only trim does not resolve failure)
chain.leading_cause: mismatch between DESI's genuinely clustered (non-i.i.d.) point process and the i.i.d.-sampling assumption underlying graph-Laplacian convergence theorems, compounded by insufficient N resolution achievable with a dense eigensolver at N=800-4000 (even the uniform i.i.d. positive control is only borderline)
chain.standard_correction_tested_and_insuffici: Coifman-Lafon alpha=1 density-normalized graph Laplacian -- does not repair DESI convergence and destabilizes the clustered synthetic control
chain.final_status: OPEN (not CLOSED, not FALSIFIED) -- CONTINUUM-LIMIT-L-DESI and MATHEMATICAL-CONVERGENCE-DESI remain Status.FAIL (retriable), Gates 2 and 3 never entered
chain.next_dependency: scale N beyond 4000 with a sparse iterative eigensolver to separate resolution-limit effects from point-process effects; see FC005_CONTINUUM_DIAGNOSTIC_REPORT.md section 16
